jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Payments
jobs.description:
Northwind Pay builds payment APIs for small businesses. Salary $170,000 to $200,000 a year.

You will design and run Python services on AWS, own PostgreSQL schemas and on-call for the payments platform.

Requirements: 5+ years of backend Python, FastAPI or Django, PostgreSQL, AWS. Nice to have: Terraform, Redis.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
Brightline Studio makes design tools for agencies. Salary $140,000 to $165,000 a year.

You will build React and TypeScript interfaces, own the component library and work closely with designers.

Requirements: 4+ years of React, TypeScript, CSS, accessibility and browser performance work.

jobs.title: Registered Nurse, ICU
jobs.description:
Lakeside Medical Center is hiring an ICU nurse for night shifts. Pay $48 to $62 an hour.

You will care for critically ill patients, give medications and work with physicians on care plans.

Requirements: active RN license in Illinois, BLS and ACLS certification, 2+ years of ICU experience.
